xht74s8b.variantName: Pelle & Sol 5ft Artificial Christmas Tree with 450 Tips - Green
xht74s8b.sourceDescription: Create a classic festive centrepiece with the Pelle & Sol 5ft Artificial Christmas Tree. The included stand provides a stable base while you arrange the branches and add your favourite baubles, ribbons, tinsel and decorative lights. Designed for straightforward assembly, the tree offers the look of traditional evergreen foliage without the maintenance of a natural tree. Suitable for indoor and outdoor decorative displays, it works well in living rooms, hallways, offices, entrances and other festive spaces. 5FT ARTIFICIAL CHRISTMAS TREE: Measures approximately 153cm tall, making it suitable for compact festive displays in homes, offices and entrances. 450 REALISTIC PINE TIPS: Features 450 green branch tips arranged to create a natural pine-inspired appearance for traditional Christmas decorating. STAND INCLUDED: Supplied with a practical stand to support the tree while shaping the branches and adding seasonal decorations. EASY TO ASSEMBLE: Designed for straightforward seasonal setup with branches that can be positioned and shaped to achieve your preferred look. INDOOR AND OUTDOOR DISPLAY: Suitable for festive decorative use in appropriate indoor and outdoor areas throughout the Christmas period. REUSABLE SEASONAL TREE: Can be carefully packed away after Christmas and brought out again for future festive celebrations. Read the instructions before use. Dreibach LTD, Unit 2 Capital Business Park, Manaor Way, WD6 1GW, United Kingdom.

rfhyaqkn.baseName: Walplus 300 LED String Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
rfhyaqkn.variantName: Walplus 300 LED String Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
rfhyaqkn.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Christmas Tree redefines seasonal decor with its sleek, cone-shaped form and warm LED lights that evoke a sense of modern elegance. Combining practicality with style, this seasonal must-have is perfect for adding a touch of sophistication to any space, whether indoors or out, making it a versatile centerpiece for homes and offices alike. Durable Materials: Crafted from premium PVC, this tree presents a lifelike appearance while ensuring durability and long-lasting use. The metal framework provides stability, supporting the tree's structure perfectly and maintaining its shape through multiple festive seasons. This combination of materials makes it both robust and visually appealing. USB Electric Connectivity: This tree includes a USB plug connection that conveniently powers the LED strip lights, eliminating the need for traditional power outlets. The easy plug-and-play setup enhances usability, allowing for effortless installation and repositioning within any space throughout the holiday season. Warm White LED Lights: A timeless choice for Christmas decorations, the LED strip lights emit a soft, warm glow to create an inviting atmosphere. These energy-efficient lights are not only visually stunning but also ensure consistent illumination without overheating, making them safe for daily use and family-friendly gatherings. Indoor and Outdoor Placement: This artificial tree is suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, offering versatility in decoration locations. Its adaptable design allows it to grace living rooms, terraces, and gardens, providing festive charm in various environments with minimal maintenance. Care &Storage Tips: For optimal maintenance, cover the tree when not in use and store it in a dry, cool place after the holiday. Regular care ensures its vibrant appearance and functionality over years, allowing you to enjoy festive moments time and again without the hassle of annual tree purchases. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and steel and plastic Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 48 cm Durable With Thick Branches Lifelike Tips Number of PVC tips: 368 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
